bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Draws a figure of the trace; computes no quantity.
bio.jane/contract.question: Draw this window of the read as a figure.

description: Draw a window of a Sanger read as an SVG figure: the four dye traces over their called bases, the per-base Phred bars and a base ruler. The same geometry the Chromatogram tab draws with, so the figure and the tab put every peak in the same place. Name the window around whatever you are asking about — a mutation site, a trim bound, an ambiguous call — because a whole 1,000-base read drawn at once shows nothing.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

bases.description: how many bases to draw. Keep it to a window you can read: past about 120 the peaks are narrower than the letters over them.

bases_row.description: print the called bases between the ruler and the peaks. Advanced.

document.description: which trace file to draw: its name (`read_F.ab1`) or its project file id. A file id is project-specific, so a template ships this unset.

from.description: first base drawn, 1-based and inclusive. Clamped into the read.

palette.description: which ink each dye is drawn in. `print` is the default here because the figure travels outside the app and onto white; `cvd` is the color-vision-deficiency-safe set. Values: classic (Classic (ABI)), cvd (Color-blind safe), print (Print (on white)).

quality.description: print the per-base Phred bars. A file with no confidence (many SCFs) draws none whatever this says.

trace_height.description: height of the peak band, under the ruler, quality and base rows. In px. Advanced.

width.description: figure width. It SETS the per-base zoom for the window asked for, never crops it. In px.

name: draw_trace

firstBase.description: first base drawn, 1-based inclusive, AFTER clamping into the read

hasQuality.description: whether this file carries per-base confidence at all

meanQuality.description: mean Phred over the window drawn, or 0 when the file carries no confidence — read `hasQuality` beside it rather than reading 0 as bad calls

sequence.description: the calls in the window drawn, so the picture and the string cannot disagree

svg.description: the trace window as an SVG figure
